latest_release.name: v0.22.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Fix missing chunking strategy in vector store file responses by @midhunmonachan in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/805
* fix(OpenAI): trim streamed response data before decoding- #9 by @e4se in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/806
* fix(OpenAI): handle undocumented text web search results- #10 by @e4se in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/807
* feat(OpenAI): add Skills API by @heyzainali in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/808
* feat(OpenAI): add shell tool and skill attachments support by @omitech in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/811
* Feature: Decisions API. by @efpapado in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/812
* fix(OpenAI): allow null names and boolean choice values in Decisions by @APX403 in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/815
* build(deps): bump shivammathur/setup-php from 2.37.2 to 2.40.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/814
* fix(OpenAI): handle rate limit and server errors on Guzzle stream requests by @APX403 in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/816
* feat(OpenAI): add Agents API by @heyzainali in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/817
* feat(OpenAI): add Vaults API by @heyzainali in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/818
* fix(OpenAI): allow null country in web search user location by @APX403 in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/821
* feat(OpenAI): add Agent Environments API by @heyzainali in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/819
* feat(OpenAI): add Agent Sessions API by @heyzainali in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/820
* fix(OpenAI): keep keys of nested multipart parameters by @APX403 in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/822
* fix(OpenAI): stop beta headers leaking into later requests by @heyzainali in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/823
* fix(chat): read reasoning_content in streamed deltas by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/824
* fix(OpenAI): support the computer tool and its batched actions by @APX403 in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/825
* fix: harden ResourceUri against HttpClient traversal (GHSA-g2jm-j3rw-vqcm) by @iBotPeaches in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/813
* Release: v0.22.0 by @iBotPeaches in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/826

## New Contributors
* @midhunmonachan made their first contribution in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/805
* @heyzainali made their first contribution in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/808
* @omitech made their first contribution in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/811
* @efpapado made their first contribution in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/812
* @APX403 made their first contribution in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/815
* @pcbeingused333 made their first contribution in https://github.com/openai-php/client/pull/824

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openai-php/client/compare/v0.21.0...v0.22.0
